name: Analysis and Design of Tunnels
description: Introduction and design concepts; tunnel failures; site investigations; primary supports: steel arches, rock bolts, shotcrete, micropiles, concrete segments; construction methods: in elastic, yielding, intense yielding grounds; tunnel boring machines: open, shield, EPB, hydroshield and hybrid TBMs, selection, RME index; bottom up and top down methods; closed form solutions; overview of design methods: Terzaghi, RMR, Q, ICE, NATM, analytical, numerical, interactive; detailed design with convergence confinement method: GCC, LDP, support curves, interaction plot; stress-strain method: 2-D and 3-D analysis, water effects, seismic effects; rock block stability by stereographic projection; grout characterization; site visit; preparation of geotechnical baseline reports; modelling of sequential excavation, GCC, LDP, supports, interaction plots.
